name: eli5
description: Create picture-led HTML explanations for people new to a topic at age5, middle, or college presentation density. Use $eli5 with a topic and optional level.

interface.shortDescription: Create visual explainers at adjustable density.
interface.longDescription: ELI5 turns a topic into a picture-led HTML artifact that assumes no prior knowledge at every level, moving from big pictures and few words at age5 to text-rich, diagram-organized college explanations.
defaultPrompt: Use $eli5 to explain how DNS works at the default age5 level.
Use $eli5 --level college to create a text-rich, diagram-organized explanation of this topic.
